payloadSchema.title: review.decision@1
payloadSchema.description: One human decision at one gate. The output of every HITL in the app; downstream executors authorize against this artifact, never against the existence of a proposal.

gate.$comment: The mock-up's nine methods: draft_approve, payment_release, classify_confirm, entity_merge, calendar_conflict, docs_delete, match_confirm, archive_confirm, upload_request. Kept as a pattern so a new gate does not need a type version.

notes: The subject (draft, payment request, duplicate check, match candidate) is a declared run input with role 'subject'; the reviewer is the run executor and the authenticated publisher may differ.
decidedVia is a const so 'voice cannot confirm; only a physical button press' (GatePreview.svelte) is auditable rather than merely enforced in the UI.
Multiple reviewers produce multiple decisions. Adjudication consumes them; it never overwrites them.
A high confidence score is not a decision. Automatic acceptance still needs a policy-evaluation run that emits its own decision artifact against an exact policy.snapshot@1.
